fontProvenance: Installed macOS/Microsoft Arial and native Apple emoji fallback. No font files are embedded by the writer.
reproduction: Generate IWorkNumbersWritingTests.Example(), decode with Build/IWork/verify-numbers-creation.py and the pinned TN/TST/TSCE descriptor set. Open a working copy in Numbers14.5, change Budget/Data B2 to20.75, save, close and reopen. Export best-quality PDF with each sheet fitted to one page, and Excel with one worksheet per table and no summary/password. Inspect every sheet/PDF page and compare native scalar values.
boundaries: This profile creates new documents only. Formulas/caches, selected formats, comments, rich cell text, merged cells, header/footer bands and loaded-source save-back are separate work.
Scalar values and native table dimensions/fonts/grid are qualified in this recorded environment. Other versions, fonts, scripts and layout combinations remain unqualified.

Native PDF uses fit-each-sheet export and localized scalar labels. Native Excel places the completely empty table at B2:D3; OfficeIMO materializes its relative two-by-three grid at A1:C2. Exact Excel positioning and native appearance equivalence are not claimed.
